paragraphs.text: Assimilate is a keyword action introduced in Star Trek . When a player assimilates a creature card, they put it onto the battlefield under their control, place a +1/+1 counter on it, and it becomes a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types .
The assimilate mechanic started out as a mechanic for the upcoming Star Trek Commander We Are the Borg deck, but was later pulled into the main set for a few cards.

Assimilation is the forceful process by which the Borg add new members and new technology to the Collective. Borg assimilation is predatory; every species the Borg encounter is assessed to determine whether its biological and/or technological distinctiveness is considered "worthy of being added to the Collective's perfection". If found to be so, the species is set upon and forcibly assimilated; the Collective considers the species' will in the matter "irrelevant".
